interested.title: Does this sound interesting?
interested.text: You don't need to know exactly what fits. That's our job.

contact.title: Get in touch for an assessment
contact.text: Send us an email or give us a call, and we'll have a no-obligation chat. We'll figure out which path will suit you best.

hero.title: New pilot offer for Gjensidige customers
hero.subtitle: We use your interests to build a sense of mastery, motivation, and a path forward in life.

image.alt: Students collaborating around a laptop in a bright office.

tracks.title: Which track is right for you?
tracks.text1: We have three main paths, depending on how old you are and what you need right now.
tracks.text2: Unsure? That's no problem. We'll figure it out together.

completeUngdomsskole.title: Staying in school
completeUngdomsskole.paragraph1: Educational concept: For those attending lower secondary school, but whose daily life is difficult and whose absence is increasing.
completeUngdomsskole.paragraph2: We use gaming and technology for educational purposes to provide you with experiences of mastery. You spend 1–2 days a week with us as a break, while we work closely with your school.

goals.goal2: Social skills training in a safe environment
goals.goal3: Goal: To thrive better and complete 10th grade

completeVGS.title: Complete upper secondary school
completeVGS.paragraph1: Educational concept: For those who have dropped out of upper secondary school, or who need another setting to complete their education.
completeVGS.paragraph2: This is an alternative learning environment. Here, you can work on your subjects, get help with homework, or study for private candidate exams at your own pace - without the stress of a classroom.

goals.goalListTitle: Goals to complete upper secondary school
goals.goal2: Focus on individual subjects or a diploma

workAndITCompetence.title: Work and IT competence
workAndITCompetence.paragraph1: Work concept: For those who are not in school or work and want to learn practical coding, design, or IT.
workAndITCompetence.paragraph2: Here, you receive practical training in the skills that companies need. We focus on "tech" and creativity as a gateway to the professional world.

goals.goalListTitle: Goals for attaining employment and IT skills
goals.goal3: The path toward an apprenticeship or a job

cost.question: Does it cost anything to participate?
cost.answer: No. For those who secure a spot through this pilot project with Gjensidige, the entire service is covered by your insurance.

treatment.question: Is this treatment or therapy?
treatment.answer: No. JobLoop is an arena for learning and mastery, not a clinic. We focus on your interests and strengths, not on diagnoses. However, we will of course make adjustments if you face challenges such as anxiety or ADHD.

skillset.question: Do I have to be super good at gaming or coding?
skillset.answer: Absolutely not! The most important this is that you have an interest in the digital realm. We tailor the level to exactly where you are, whether you are a beginner or have been at it for a long time.

school.question: Will i lose my place at the school?
school.answer: No. Specifically for the "Education Concept," we work closely with your school to ensure you retain your student status, Our goal is to help you complete your studies.

workFromHome.question: What happens if I don't feel comfortable showing up in person?
workFromHome.answer: We fully understand that taking the first step can be daunting. That is why we can start digitally - via Discord or Teams - so that you feel comfortable with your mentor before meeting us in person.

uncertain.title: Uncertain if this is for you?
uncertain.text: We have created a guide to help you prepare for the conversation. Here, you can read more about what we will discuss and what might be useful to consider in advance.

hero.title: New offer from Gjensidige & JobLoop
hero.subtitle: We use your interests to build a sense of mastery, motivation, and a path forward in life.
hero.paragraph1: This is not an interview or a test. It is an informal, no-obligation chat where we will figure out together what works best for you.
hero.paragraph2: We are here to listen to you, understand your interests, and help you find your way forward. You don't need to be nervous or prepared for anything in particular - we meet you exactly where you are.
hero.paragraph3: The conversation is about you, your dreams, and what you wish to achieve. Together, we will determine which path best suits your situation.

beforeMeeting.title: Before the conversation
beforeMeeting.paragraph1: This is an offer from Gjensidige and JobLoop. At JobLoop, we are excited to have the opportunity to get to know you!
beforeMeeting.paragraph2: There's no need to worry - we are here to help you find the way forward.

remember.title: Remember:
remember.paragraph1: You don't need to be an expert in anything at all. The most important thing is that you have an interest in the digital realm, or that you are curious to learn. We tailor everything to exactly where you are.
remember.paragraph2: It's perfectly fine if you don't know everything yet - that's precisely why we're going to talk. We'll figure it out together!

talkingSoon.title: Talk to you soon!
talkingSoon.paragraph1: We look forward to hearing from you and figuring out together which path suits you best.
talkingSoon.paragraph2: You don't need to be nervous or prepare for anything in particular. This is just a pleasant chat where we get to know each other.

afterMeeting.title: After the conversation
afterMeeting.text: After we have spoken, we will assess what is best for you. We will provide feedback on which path we recommend, and then we can get started whenever you are ready.

outro.title: We look forward to speaking with you!
